author: blu
body: A badge carries both a colour and a tone because they answer different questions. The colour is a literal hex value for a caller that paints one itself; the tone is what the badge MEANS, which is what a widget tree can carry and a theme can resolve. Deriving one from the other is what this chapter must not do: the constructors below know the meaning at the moment they pick the colour, and recovering it afterwards from a hex value would be reading intent back out of appearance.

author: blu
body: Four bars is Urgent and none is None, so the count is the whole of what a priority bar says. It is the maximum a BsPriorityBar can carry and the denominator the widget renders against.
